title: Little Girl in White Dress on Front Porch, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century black-and-white snapshot of a toddler girl standing on the front porch of a brick suburban home. Dressed in a ruffled white dress, bobby socks, and white hard-soled toddler shoes with her dark hair swept into a small ponytail, she grasps a decorative black wrought-iron support column while looking aside. Behind her, a screen door displays the house number '3081' above a geometric pattern doormat, evoking quintessential 1950s American family life.
